bugLogs.title: Low contrast price text on search results
steps_to_reproduce: Locate price spans in results 3, 4, and 5
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Price text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Price text has a contrast ratio of 1.87:1, failing WCAG 2.1 AA
bugLogs.suggested_fix: In the CSS rule for .result:nth-child(3) > div > span, change color from #bdbdbd to #757575 (4.61:1 on #ffffff; measured 1.87:1, required 4.5:1).
bugLogs.element_selector: .result:nth-child(3) > div > span, .result:nth-child(4) > div > span, .result:nth-child(5) > div > span

bugLogs.title: Missing alt text on product images
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Each informative image must have a descriptive alt attribute
bugLogs.actual_behavior: All three product images lack alt, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, and role attributes
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add descriptive alt text to each image, e.g., , ,

bugLogs.title: Next page link lacks discernible text
steps_to_reproduce: Tab to the next page link
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The link should have visible or accessible text that indicates its purpose, such as "Next page" or an aria-label.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The link element has no visible text, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title attribute, making it inaccessible to keyboard and screen reader users.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add an aria-label to the link:

bugLogs.title: Missing accessible name on #sort select element
steps_to_reproduce: Locate the select element with id="sort"
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The select control should have an accessible name announced by assistive technology, e.g., "Sort by"
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The select element has no associated label, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title, so screen readers announce it as "listbox" with no name
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a visible label and associate it with the select: <label for="sort">Sort by</label> before the <select id="sort"> element
